stages.label: Contract
stages.hint: story or issue to a signed-off plan and a draft PR

stages.label: Build
stages.hint: split into tasks, tiered workers, test-first

stages.label: Quality gate
stages.hint: lint and slop signals on the diff, decided one by one

stages.label: Browser verify
stages.hint: blind verifier, one check per Test Step

stages.label: Second review
stages.hint: another model tries to break it

stages.label: Fix comments
stages.hint: clear defects fixed, the rest parked

stages.label: Report
stages.hint: evidence to the PR; a human merges

stages.label: Human review
stages.hint: reviewer comments settled until a human merges or closes

stages.label: Retro
stages.hint: every correction becomes a lesson, and a check where one can catch it
